{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check if any patient has more than one row
print(df['patient_id'].value_counts().max())

# Check which patient_ids are duplicated
duplicates = df[df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(duplicates['patient_id'].unique())"}
